title: He would be a priest for ever according to the order of Melchisedec
html_source: Melchisedec was the first priest mentioned in the Bible. According to Genesis, he was both a king and a priest and was described as “Priest of God Most High.” Jesus was considered a priest in the Order of Melchisedec (because he was not a descended of Aaron and therefore could not be a part of the Jewish priesthood). Today, priests are ordained to “The Order of Melchisedec” (also spelled Melchizedek). If Stephen had become a priest, he would have been a member of their order as well.
